title: Upstream v0.12.0: node-quickbooks 2.0.48 → 2.0.50
reason: quickbooks-mcp released v0.12.0 (611ca6d, 2026-10-19). Its lockfile moves node-quickbooks from 2.0.48 to 2.0.50. None of the 27 files the adopted create_invoice tool executes changed between ce1317e and 611ca6d (only src/types/node-quickbooks.d.ts, a declaration file, and code outside the tool's import graph: lambda.ts, tools/definitions.ts, tools/index.ts, handlers/vendor.ts). Following upstream keeps the deployment on the client version upstream ships and tests.
originalBehavior: node-quickbooks 2.0.48: requests with minorversion=75 and User-Agent 'node-quickbooks: version 2.0.48'
replacementBehavior: node-quickbooks 2.0.50: index.js is byte-identical to 2.0.48 (the release adds index.d.ts type declarations); the only runtime-visible difference is the version in the User-Agent header
evidence: upstream: git diff ce1317e 611ca6d -- <the 27 executed files> is empty; package-lock.json node-quickbooks 2.0.48 → 2.0.50
npm: node-quickbooks@2.0.48 and @2.0.50 tarballs — index.js identical; 2.0.50 adds index.d.ts and a "types" field
assumptions: Intuit treats the User-Agent as informational (it does not change how requests are processed).
Request-Id (a random UUID per request, set by node-quickbooks) differs on every request in either version.
validation: replay the customer's own create_invoice requests through the artifact before and after against a recording QuickBooks double: identical method, path, query and body; headers identical apart from User-Agent and Request-Id
the 27 executed files are unchanged (same sha256 in both artifacts)
the previous artifact still loads (rollback target)
rollback: Roll back the correction: the artifact links node-quickbooks 2.0.48 again. Invoices created while it was active stay as created.
